svg.title: memorizz repository overview
svg.desc: Architecture poster of the memorizz repository: entry points (CLI, web UI, MCP server, Python SDK) drive the MemAgent runtime, which retrieves and persists memory through semantic, procedural, episodic, short-term and shared memory systems backed by pluggable storage providers (filesystem, MongoDB, Oracle). The model layer (LLM and embedding providers) sits on the left, optional capability packages on the right, repository scaffolding in the sidebar and the agent.run request lifecycle along the bottom.
